title: Retro Rooftop Lounge! 8 Beds! Garage Parking!
description:
Enjoy the this Avant-Garde retro inspired space! Located in East Nashville, this place is a short walk from many bars and restaurants, as well as a short cab to and from downtown, the grand ole opry, and both stadiums as well as other attractions!

The space
This is a 4 story property:

First Floor
 :: Garage and astral entrance
 :: Bedroom with 2 Queen beds
 :: Full Bathroom

Second Floor
 :: Full Kitchen
 :: Dining Table
 :: Living room with TV
 :: Half Bathroom
 :: 2 Beds in Living Room

Third Floor
 :: Master Bedroom with king mattress and Full Bathroom
 :: Bedroom with 3 Queen beds
 :: Full Bathroom

Fourth Floor
 :: Rooftop Lounge!

Guest access
This is an entire private condo for rent, garage included. 

You may check in any time after 3PM on your check-in date. If you are going to check in late, please let us know so we can give you any contingency check-in plans!

Other things to note
We do not host any locals. No parties, and no gatherings of any sort. 

We do require a rental agreement to be signed outside of Airbnb.
